auditChanges: MLB Braves @ Dodgers: Second Opinion now Dodgers lean (4-0); removed false Freeman injury and 1-5 series claims
MLB Yankees @ Rays: swapped run-line prices corrected (NYY +1.5 -210, TB -1.5 +172)
MLB Padres @ Brewers: Vaughn is active, injury cluster is single-weight; tally 2-1, still a pass

altReasons: Scoring margin: White Sox +56 season run differential vs Guardians +11 (gap 45, >=15) favors White Sox
Injuries/Lineup: Guardians reliever Colin Holderman (right wrist) is out for the entire postseason and will need surgery; White Sox report no injuries, favors White Sox
Form: Guardians enter red-hot at 24-10 over their last 34 games, favors Guardians
Matchup splits: Guardians have hit just .227/.634 OPS as a team against left-handed pitching this season and White Sox are starting lefty Hagen Smith, favors White Sox
Scoring margin: Dodgers +201 season run differential vs Braves +116 (gap 85, >=15) favors Dodgers

Rest: Braves needed a win-or-go-home Game 3 of the Wild Card Series on Oct. 1 (Chris Sale pitched in relief to close it out), leaving them one off day and a heavily used bullpen; Dodgers had a first-round bye and are fully rested, favors Dodgers
Travel: Braves travel cross-country from Atlanta to Los Angeles with a 3-hour time change on a short turnaround, favors Dodgers

Matchup splits: Dodgers deliberately started lefty Tarik Skubal over Yoshinobu Yamamoto to exploit the Braves' .696 OPS against left-handed pitching this season (vs .730 against righties), favors Dodgers
games.auditNote: Removed the Freddie Freeman ankle-sprain reason (Freeman is healthy for the NLDS) and the '1-5 vs Dodgers' claim (Braves won the season series 5-1); tally is 4-0, so the Second Opinion is a Dodgers lean (it was stored as pass with a pick).

altReasons: Scoring margin: Yankees +138 season run differential vs Rays +86 (gap 52, >=15) favors Yankees
Injuries/Lineup: Three-time AL MVP Aaron Judge was left off the Yankees' ALDS roster with a right calf/soleus strain, favors Rays
Weather/Venue: Yankees are 34-45 at Tropicana Field since 2016, where the turf and roof backdrop have historically hurt them, favors Rays
Market: Rays are priced at -134 despite early public betting leaning toward New York (52%-48%), favors Rays

Matchup splits: Rays have 7 above-average hitters vs RHP this season (only 3 vs LHP) and draw RHP Gerrit Cole tonight; Yankees are also just 4-6 against Tampa Bay in their last 10 head-to-head meetings, favors Rays
games.auditNote: Run-line prices were swapped: Yankees +1.5 is -210 and Rays -1.5 is +172 (Covers consensus).

altReasons: Scoring margin: Brewers +214 season run differential vs Padres +41 (gap 173, >=15) favors Brewers

Injuries/Lineup: Brewers SS Joey Ortiz is limited with a bruised knee and sore oblique/groin (single-player, weight x1), favors Padres
